company.name: Linktree
company.shortDescription: Linktree provides a link-in-bio platform for sharing content, selling products, and analyzing audience activity.
company.description: Linktree provides a link-in-bio platform that combines multiple online destinations in one shareable page. Users can connect social profiles, websites, stores, and other content, then distribute the page through social platforms or QR codes. The platform also supports social media scheduling, automated replies, contact collection, digital product sales, sponsored links, appointments, and audience analytics. It serves creators, businesses, and organizations that manage content, audience engagement, and online transactions.
